intro.title: What is an AI calling bot?
intro.definition: is a voice agent on your phone line. It answers or places calls, understands what the caller says, replies in a natural voice in their language, books slots, takes details and passes the call to a person whenever it should — on the same numbers your customers already call.

benefits.title: Why businesses choose Exyconn for voice automation

items.text: Answers in about a second, around the clock, with no hold music.
Speaks Hindi, English and other Indian languages, and understands mixed Hinglish.
Lets callers interrupt — it stops, listens and answers, like a person would.

Hands over to your team with the full context when a person is needed.

props.label: FAQ
props.title: Questions about the AI calling bot

items.question: How do I try the live demo?
items.answer: Open demos.exyconn.com/calling-bot-demo, sign in with your email and a one-time code, and press Start the call to talk to the bot from your browser. If phone calls are enabled, enter your number and the bot rings you within seconds.

items.question: Which languages does the bot speak?
items.answer: Hindi, English and the major Indian languages — Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil and Telugu. The bot listens and answers in the caller's language.

items.question: How fast does it answer?
items.answer: The bot listens, thinks and speaks as a stream, so it usually starts answering within about a second of the caller finishing. You can interrupt it at any time and it stops to listen.

items.question: Can it call real phone numbers?
items.answer: Yes. We connect the bot to an Indian telephony number, so it can take inbound calls and place outbound calls to mobiles and landlines, with a time limit and a full transcript of every call.

items.question: What happens to the call recordings and transcripts?
items.answer: Every call keeps a transcript you can review. Data stays in your account, access is limited to your team, and we follow your retention rules.
